==Usage==
To use this template, paste <code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>UserSW|{{Var|level}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code> into your user page, where <code>{{Var|level}}</code> is either <code>0</code>, <code>1</code>, <code>2</code>, <code>3</code>, or <code>w</code>.
